text_run.content: This operation lists all bulk-import jobs of a specific cluster.

list_import_jobs(
    url: str,
    api_key: str,
    cluster_id: str,
The endpoint URL of your Zilliz Cloud cluster.
For example, the endpoint URL should be in the following format:
with the ID of the region that accommodates your cluster. You can get the cloud region ID from the endpoint URL of your cluster.
The URI of your Milvus instance.
key with sufficient permissions to manipulate the cluster, or
A pair of username and password of the target cluster joined by a colon(:).
The instance ID of the target cluster of this operation.
You can get the instance ID of a cluster on its details page from the Zilliz Cloud console.
The name of the target collection of this bulk-import job.
The ID of this bulk-import job.
The state of this bulk-import job. Possible values are as follows:
: The tasks are awaiting scheduling and execution;
: The tasks are currently being executed;
: The tasks have been successfully completed;

import json
from pymilvus.bulk_writer import list_import_jobs

resp = list_import_jobs(
    api_key=API_KEY,
    url=CLOUD_API_ENDPOINT,
    cluster_id=CLUSTER_ID
)

print(json.dumps(resp.json(), indent=4))
